description: Authoritative industrial source catalog (RECOVERY_2026-05-10 §3, Gap C). Every source is tagged with authority_tier (1=regulatory/standards/codes, 2=peer-reviewed/handbooks/national-lab, 3=industry whitepapers/vendor/case studies), asset_families it applies to, jurisdiction, and topic_tags. Consumed by motor_035 (source routing) and motor_062 (scenario justification).

tier_definitions.1: Regulatory, codes, mandatory standards. Highest evidentiary weight.
tier_definitions.2: Peer-reviewed engineering handbooks, national laboratory reports, official industry consensus standards.
tier_definitions.3: Vendor application guides, industry whitepapers, trade-association case studies, market reports. Lower evidentiary weight but useful for process clues.
